finding.title: Split the 4 hand-written tracks/setup files over the 400-line AG-3 cap
finding.why: track_creation_service.dart is 438 lines, add_track_flow_screen.dart is 989, edit_track_screen.dart is 1011, track_detail_screen.dart is 994 — all over the stated 400-line cap for hand-written files. Each mixes multiple responsibilities (persistence + state machine + widget tree + business rules) in one file; two of them (add_track_flow_screen.dart, track_detail_screen.dart) are named HOTSPOTs in this audit's own churn list, meaning every fix wave touches an already-oversized file.
finding.recommendation: Extract step-builders/dialogs into separate widget files per screen; extract track_creation_service.dart's post-commit cloud-push block into its own class.
acceptance_criteria: `find lib -name '*.dart' ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'` no longer lists these 4 files

finding.title: Convert hand-written Provider/StreamProvider/FutureProvider.family declarations in tracks/setup to @riverpod codegen
finding.why: SM-1 is a Pending rule and this hand-written-constructor style is a pervasive, pre-existing repo-wide pattern (not unique to this batch), so today's cost is convention drift rather than a runtime defect; reported per the digest instruction that Pending-rule violations are novel findings and count NEW additions.
finding.recommendation: Migrate these 6 providers to @riverpod functions/classes opportunistically when the surrounding file is next touched.
acceptance_criteria: The 6 listed providers are declared with @riverpod codegen instead of raw Provider/StreamProvider/FutureProvider constructors

finding.title: Route track_management_hub_screen's error text and edit_track_screen's validation sentinel through AppLocalizations
finding.rule: AX-2 (no hardcoded user-facing strings) / EH-5 (no pre-formatted human messages) / custom lint no_e_to_string_in_ui

evidence.quote: name.trim().isEmpty ? 'Track name cannot be empty.' : null;

finding.why: Text('Error: $e') renders a raw, untranslated exception string directly to Hebrew-locale users if activeTracksProvider's stream ever errors — exactly the shape the (currently non-functional) no_e_to_string_in_ui custom lint targets. validateTrackName's hardcoded return string is never actually displayed today (the only call site null-checks it and shows l10n.trackEditNameRequired instead), but returning a natural-language string from a validator invites a future direct-display bug.
finding.recommendation: Replace the error branch with a localized generic error string; change validateTrackName's signature to return bool (or a stable enum) instead of a message string.
acceptance_criteria: No raw Text('Error: $e')-style interpolation remains in tracks/setup presentation code
validateTrackName no longer returns a natural-language string

finding.title: Move curriculum_activation_service_test.dart to mirror its lib path under features/tracks
finding.why: The service now lives under features/tracks/domain/services/ (git log shows the move happened in commit 43b6de92, 'delete duplicate feature trees ... + settings service duplicates'), but its only test suite still sits at the pre-move features/settings/domain/services/ path. A contributor searching test/features/tracks/ for this live, actively-used service's coverage will wrongly conclude it is untested.
finding.recommendation: git mv the test file to test/features/tracks/domain/services/curriculum_activation_service_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: Test file path mirrors the lib path 1:1 per AG-5

finding.title: Replace EdgeInsets.only(left:/right:) with EdgeInsetsDirectional in track_management_hub_screen
finding.why: Banned API for an RTL (Hebrew) app. Today left and right are both 16 so the symmetric padding happens to render identically either direction, but it's a copy-pasteable bad example, and it is invisible to the repo's one AX-1 grep (root Makefile line 184) because that grep matches only within a single line and this call is dart-format-wrapped across 5 lines — any genuinely asymmetric EdgeInsets.only(left:, right:) formatted the same way would ship completely undetected.
finding.recommendation: Switch to EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start:, end:, top:, bottom:); fix the root Makefile's AX-1 grep to scan a joined/multi-line window instead of single lines.
acceptance_criteria: The root Makefile's AX-1 grep catches a multi-line-formatted EdgeInsets.only(left:...) test fixture
